text:
maria_product: Heads-up — BrightHealth (pilot) just hit their soft quota during a scheduled spike. They pinged sales asking for an immediate uplift. We don’t have a clear "escape path" documented for pilot-to-GA customers. Can we sketch one now?

kevin_sales: Saw that. They want a one-off uplift and an SLA carve-out while they ramp. Risk: we can’t promise GA SLAs to pilots. Need guardrails. :grimacing:

anna_pm: Propose a controlled uplift flow: 1) temporary boost token (7 days max), 2) mandatory post-mortem + usage shaping plan, 3) opt-in to Dedicated queue if sustained. Launch criteria should require that no pilot has >2 temporary boosts before GA. Thoughts?

lisa_research: Agree on the flow. Also add a quality/regression check: if uplifted traffic shows >=3% failure or degraded latency, auto-throttle and require mitigation plan.

sanjay_eng: Implementation notes: we can support a "boost-token" feature in Console: code snippet for API

```
POST /v1/admin/boosts
{ "customer": "brighthealth", "duration_hours": 168, "max_tps": 50 }
```

Backend already has capability to pin capacity by customer for Dedicated — enabling tokens for Hosted requires a small routing change. ETA: 2w for safe rollout + canary.

kevin_sales: That ETA is fine but customer is pushing. Can we do manual grant today via ops?

maria_product: Ops manual grant okay as one-off, but we need canned messaging and a checklist for SAs. Also legal needs a note: no implied SLA. Kevin, can you confirm messaging?

kevin_sales: I’ll send a template: one-off uplift granted, expires in 7 days, no SLA changes, we’ll schedule follow-up.

anna_pm: For roadmap: add a "Pilot escape path" card to the pack-slabs epic with acceptance criteria:
- Console option to request boost (UI + API)
- Boost quota capped per-customer and per-org
- Post-boost mandatory review flow with owner assignment
- Metrics surfaced in Console (boosts granted, duration, impact on latency/errors)
- Legal-approved uplift T&Cs

Acceptance = UI + API + 2 canary grants + docs.

lisa_research: Add alerting rule: when any single org uses >50% of boost capacity more than once in 30d, trigger product-review.

sanjay_eng: Noted. For SLA/contract constraints: we should ensure boosts can't be used to game trial terms (e.g., convert to long-term throughput claims). Enforce through telemetry and contract flagging.

maria_product: Sounds good. Action items:
- sanjay_eng: prototype API + routing changes (create ticket) — due EOD today for triage
- anna_pm: add roadmap card + acceptance criteria
- kevin_sales: send customer messaging template and notify BrightHealth ops uplift scheduled
- lisa_research: draft alert thresholds for review
- ops_bot: please record manual uplift when applied and tag the ticket

ops_bot: Reminder recorded: Create ticket INF-8421 for manual uplift audit. Will ping #eng-oncall when manual grant happens. :white_check_mark:

kevin_sales: Template sent to BrightHealth, requesting acknowledgement. Grant scheduled for 10:00 UTC once ops confirms.

maria_product: Thanks all — aim to review this thread in next Tues triage. If any blockers to manual uplift, call out here.

sanjay_eng: Creating INF-8422 (prototype boost API + routing change) now. ETA for canary: 2w, but will try to surface interim manual playbook asap.

anna_pm: Note for GA launch criteria doc: add a clause limiting "pilot boosts" to not count towards committed reservation negotiations. Prevents misaligned expectations.

kevin_sales: Noted and will align with legal on contract language.

maria_product: Closing loop: we want a short public doc (internal) titled "Pilot escape path: temporary boosts & escalation" — anna_pm take lead.

anna_pm: On it. Will share draft by EOD Friday.
